label: The genus principle at being only: whatever is maximal…, via attribution genus principle at being
meaning: On the reading by attribution, the genus principle holds at being: from the order of being by approach to a primary (q.3 a.5 ad 2), strict primacy (open, unattributed), the causal order of creatures to the primary (q.13 a.5) and that everything other than the primary is a creature (open, unattributed), by excluded middle. Only the instance at being is derived. Omission countermodels (in the Solution) show that the causal order, strict primacy and the creature premise are each needed. Since the CREATURE disambiguation (2026-11-12) the creature premise is read at CREATURE_1 (caused in one's being by a cause of the being of every other being in act), so it already carries the existence of a universal cause of being, close to this conclusion: a warrant burden on that premise, not a gap in the derivation.
